privacyPage.demo: Demonstration document — controller and service-provider details must be confirmed before publication.
privacyPage.controllerText: The data controller is {controller}. Privacy enquiries: {email}.
privacyPage.scopeText: The server may process technical connection data required to display the website securely. If you send an email or message, we process the contact information and correspondence you provide.
privacyPage.purposeText: Technical data is used to provide, diagnose, secure and maintain the website. Correspondence data is used to answer enquiries, arrange performances or cooperation, or handle another matter described in the message.
privacyPage.legalBasisText: Website operation, security and ordinary correspondence rely on the controller's legitimate interest in maintaining the service and communication (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR). Where contact is intended to enter into or perform a contract, Article 6(1)(b) GDPR may apply. Optional analytics is enabled on the basis of consent.
privacyPage.retentionText: Technical data is retained for the period resulting from the hosting provider's security and retention settings. Correspondence is retained until the matter is completed and afterwards only for as long as necessary to establish, pursue or defend claims or meet legal obligations.
privacyPage.analyticsText: Analytics is currently disabled. If enabled in the future, Cloudflare Web Analytics will load only after consent and the choice will be stored locally in the browser. Consent can be changed in the footer. The website does not load embedded players from music services.
privacyPage.recipientsText: The website is hosted by GitHub Pages. Correspondence may be handled by Google (Gmail) or Meta (Messenger), depending on the selected contact method. Press materials are shared through Google Drive. If analytics is enabled, Cloudflare will be its provider. Providers receive data only to the extent needed to deliver their services.
privacyPage.transfersText: Some technology providers operate globally and may process data outside the European Economic Area. In such cases, the transfer should rely on an appropriate legal mechanism used by that provider, such as an adequacy decision or standard contractual clauses.
privacyPage.externalLinksText: Spotify, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, Messenger and Google Drive open only after a click. From that point, the user accesses an external service under its operator's terms.
privacyPage.rightsText: You may request access, rectification, erasure or restriction, data portability where provided by law, object to processing and lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority. Optional analytics consent may be withdrawn at any time without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing.
privacyPage.voluntaryText: Providing data in a message is voluntary, but handling the enquiry may be impossible without details that allow a response. The website does not make automated decisions about users and does not perform profiling.
